trunk_step: 1 of 4 (MoE / epsilon remediation or explicit ablation)

verified_findings.F1_never_live_in_eval: eval_moe_liveness_pass is false on 38/38 rows. eval n_alive==1 and load==[1,0,0,0] on epochs 0-13 (pre-floor and floor row) and n_alive stays 1 through epoch 15. The gate's collapsed_at_epoch=13 / '0 epochs after floor' is just the first post-floor row; the router was never live in eval, so the stamp does not show that eps->0 caused a collapse.
verified_findings.F2_eps_is_train_only: moe.py TopologyAwareHardMoE._route applies the eps override only when self.training; eval is argmax and ignores eps. eps decay cannot directly change eval routing, only which experts receive gradient during training.
verified_findings.F3_partial_recovery_still_fails: Post-floor n_alive peaks at 3 (epochs 25-26), entropy_norm peaks at 0.591 (epoch 29) vs 0.85 floor, load_min is 0.0 on every row, expert 2 has eval load 0.0 on all 38 rows; final load [0, 0.217, 0, 0.783].
verified_findings.F4_protocol: One optimizer step per epoch on a single round-robin structure (38 steps total); eval routing is measured on the structure just trained on (not held-out), one seed (torch.manual_seed(0)).
verified_findings.F5_coeffs_already_high: cv_coeff=10, moe_quota_coeff=5, eval_proxy_quota_coeff=140 under the locked tokyo_eye_equ_moe_eval_util gate. More coefficient escalation is the forbidden silent retune.
verified_findings.F6_no_ablation_switch: grep of science/tokyo_eye/v8/model.py and experiments/training/v8/run_v8_experiment.py finds no MoE-ablation flag; Option A needs a small flag-gated code change.

evidence.isolated_router_stamp_note: tokyo_eye_equ_epsilon_decay_floor_hold.json (synthetic 4-cluster, final load [0.125,0,0.648,0.227]) is not used as evidence here.

R_remediate_single_shot.change: Exactly one structural change, no coefficient/schedule change: each epoch, gradients are averaged over all 12 Stage-A-12 structures and applied in ONE optimizer step (same step count and lr as the stamp). Eval liveness is measured on pooled nodes of all 12 structures (node-weighted) in addition to the per-structure rows.
R_remediate_single_shot.rationale: F4: the gate sees one structure per step and is scored on that same structure; F1: liveness fails from init, before any eps effect. This tests whether gradient/eval diversity alone makes routing multi-expert.
R_remediate_single_shot.on_fail: automatic fallback to Option A for step 3; no second remediation without a new signed card

A_ablate_explicit.change: Add flag-gated moe_mode in {live (default), ablated}. ablated = routing fixed one-hot to expert 0; experts 1-3 not executed; gate params excluded from the optimizer; cv/quota/switch/eval_proxy/majority/soft_quota terms and the eps override are not computed. MLflow tags: moe_mode=ablated, moe_claim=none, diagnostic=true, do_not_promote=true.
A_ablate_explicit.rationale: Step 4 needs an ablated arm for the MoE-on vs ablated comparison regardless of how R turns out.
A_ablate_explicit.rejected_variant: Dense/soft mean over experts as the ablation - violates the frozen hard=True one-hot contract.

A0_attribution_note.change: Sidecar note only (no edit to the original stamp): relabel attribution of the full-spine result from COLLAPSED_POST_FLOOR to NEVER_LIVE_IN_EVAL_FROM_INIT under the verdict table below. Zero compute.

recommended_default: A0 + R (single shot, seeds 0/1/2) with pre-declared automatic fallback to A. Build the A flag in parallel because step 4 needs it either way.

pass_fail_bars.thresholds_source: data/gates/tokyo_eye_equ_moe_eval_util_pins.json (locked; NOT relaxed): min_load>=0.10, n_alive>=4 at alive_floor 0.05, entropy_norm>=0.85

R.P1_hold: PASS iff on EVERY post-floor row (floor_epoch..floor_epoch+24, 25 rows) the pooled 12-structure eval routing passes all three moe_eval_utilization sub-gates, for ALL 3 seeds. Any failing row on any seed = FAIL.
R.P2_finite: PASS iff no non-finite loss/grad on any seed.
R.P3_no_ablation_leak: PASS iff moe_mode==live and all schedule/coeff pins below are byte-identical to the pins in this card.

verdict_table.HELD: P1 and P2 and P3 pass. MoE-on remains a candidate for step 3; step 4 MoE-on arm is meaningful.
verdict_table.COLLAPSED_POST_FLOOR: pooled eval liveness passes on the last pre-floor row (floor_epoch-1) on that seed, then fails post-floor. eps-attributable. Fall back to A.
verdict_table.NEVER_LIVE: pooled eval liveness fails on the last pre-floor row. Not eps-attributable. Fall back to A; MoE-on labelled unhealthy in step 4.
verdict_table.ABORT_NONFINITE: P2 fails. Fall back to A.

A.A1_default_bit_identical: PASS iff with moe_mode=live the model output on one fixed batch (seed 0, 1MBN:A) has max abs diff == 0 vs the pre-change code.
A.A2_ablation_exact: PASS iff with moe_mode=ablated: eval load == [1,0,0,0]; all listed MoE loss terms == 0 exactly; gate param grads are None; experts 1-3 never called.
A.A3_pure_hyp_holds: PASS iff the pure_hyp full-spine scan (2 tau cases x 12 structures) still returns pure_hyp_pass=true with moe_mode=ablated.
A.A4_finite_train: PASS iff the 38-epoch round-robin run stays finite. No performance bar.
A.claim_rule: decay_floor_hold is recorded N/A_ABLATED, never PASS. Load [1,0,0,0] is by construction and is not MoE evidence.

operator_decisions.P1_hold_window: KEEP every post-floor row (25 rows) — do not soften
operator_decisions.seeds: ALL 3 seeds (0,1,2) must pass P1 — any seed fail = R FAIL
operator_decisions.R_gradient_aggregation: MEAN over 12 structures (one optimizer step). Prefer mean over sum so loss/grad scale stays comparable to the single-structure baseline; do not multiply lr.
operator_decisions.path: A0 attribution sidecar + build A (moe_mode) in parallel + single-shot R; on R FAIL auto-fallback to A for step 3
